verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a team collaboration and work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no native Asana whiteboard. The Figma/FigJam widget and Canva listings are third-party integrations in the app directory, which are adjacent tools rather than Asana's own whiteboard capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
